label: Table Layout (contextual tab)
purpose: contextual ribbon tab of the 'Table Tools' family; exists only while: selection is inside a table. Groups: Table, Draw, Rows & Columns, Merge, Cell Size, Alignment, Data. Appeared on the 'table' probe.

children.label: Select
children.tooltip: Select the current cell, row, column, or entire table.
children.state_notes: group 'Table'; keytip Alt, J L, K; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: View Gridlines
children.tooltip: Show or hide the gridlines in the table.
children.state_notes: group 'Table'; keytip Alt, J L, T G; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Properties...
children.tooltip: Show the Table Properties dialog box to change advanced table properties, such as indentation and text wrapping options.
children.state_notes: group 'Table'; keytip Alt, J L, O; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Draw Table
children.tooltip:
Design your own table by drawing the cell, row and column borders yourself.

You can even draw diagonal lines and cells within cells.
children.state_notes: group 'Draw'; keytip Alt, J L, T A; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Eraser
children.tooltip: Remove specific borders in a table to create merged cells.
children.state_notes: group 'Draw'; keytip Alt, J L, S E; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Delete
children.tooltip: Delete rows, columns, cells, or the entire table.
children.state_notes: group 'Rows & Columns'; keytip Alt, J L, D; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Insert Row Above

icon.description: Insert Row Above control (see icon crop)

children.tooltip: Add a new row directly above the current row.
children.state_notes: group 'Rows & Columns'; keytip Alt, J L, A; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Insert Row Below

icon.description: Insert Row Below control (see icon crop)

children.tooltip: Add a new row directly below the current row.
children.state_notes: group 'Rows & Columns'; keytip Alt, J L, B E; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Insert Column Left

icon.description: Insert Column Left control (see icon crop)

children.tooltip: Add a new column directly to the left of the current column.
children.state_notes: group 'Rows & Columns'; keytip Alt, J L, L; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Insert Column Right

icon.description: Insert Column Right control (see icon crop)

children.tooltip: Add a new column directly to the right of the current column.
children.state_notes: group 'Rows & Columns'; keytip Alt, J L, R; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Insert Cells...
children.tooltip: Show the Insert Cells dialog box.
children.state_notes: group 'Rows & Columns'; keytip Alt, J L, I; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Merge Cells
children.tooltip: Merge the selected cells into one cell.
children.state_notes: group 'Merge'; keytip Alt, J L, M; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Split Cells...
children.tooltip: Split the current cell into multiple cells.
children.state_notes: group 'Merge'; keytip Alt, J L, P; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Split Table
children.tooltip:
Split the table into two tables.

The current row will become the first row of the new table.
children.state_notes: group 'Merge'; keytip Alt, J L, Q; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: AutoFit
children.tooltip:
Automatically resize the columns in your table.

Set your columns to be the same width as your content or choose for your table to stretch across the page.
children.state_notes: group 'Cell Size'; keytip Alt, J L, F; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: More
children.tooltip: Set the height of the selected cells.
children.state_notes: group 'Cell Size'; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Less
children.tooltip: Set the height of the selected cells.
children.state_notes: group 'Cell Size'; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: More
children.tooltip: Set the width of the selected cells.
children.state_notes: group 'Cell Size'; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Less
children.tooltip: Set the width of the selected cells.
children.state_notes: group 'Cell Size'; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Distribute Rows
children.tooltip: Distribute the height of the selected rows equally between them.
children.state_notes: group 'Cell Size'; keytip Alt, J L, U R; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Distribute Columns
children.tooltip: Distribute the width of the selected columns equally between them.
children.state_notes: group 'Cell Size'; keytip Alt, J L, U C; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Properties...
children.tooltip: Show the Table Properties dialog box to change advanced table properties, such as indentation and text wrapping options.
children.state_notes: group 'Cell Size'; keytip Alt, J L, O; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Align Top Left

icon.description: Align Top Left control (see icon crop)

children.tooltip: Align text to the top left corner of the cell.
children.state_notes: group 'Alignment'; keytip Alt, J L, T L; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Align Top Center

icon.description: Align Top Center control (see icon crop)

children.tooltip: Center text and align it to the top of the cell.
children.state_notes: group 'Alignment'; keytip Alt, J L, T C; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Align Top Right

icon.description: Align Top Right control (see icon crop)

children.tooltip: Align text to the top right corner of the cell.
children.state_notes: group 'Alignment'; keytip Alt, J L, T R; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Align Center Left

icon.description: Align Center Left control (see icon crop)

children.tooltip: Center text vertically and align it to the left side of the cell.
children.state_notes: group 'Alignment'; keytip Alt, J L, C L; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Align Center
children.tooltip: Center text horizontally and vertically within the cell.
children.state_notes: group 'Alignment'; keytip Alt, J L, C C; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Align Center Right

icon.description: Align Center Right control (see icon crop)

children.tooltip: Center text vertically and align it to the right side of the cell.
children.state_notes: group 'Alignment'; keytip Alt, J L, C R; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Align Bottom Left

icon.description: Align Bottom Left control (see icon crop)

children.tooltip: Align text to the bottom left corner of the cell.
children.state_notes: group 'Alignment'; keytip Alt, J L, B L; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Align Bottom Center

icon.description: Align Bottom Center control (see icon crop)

children.tooltip: Center text and align it to the bottom of the cell.
children.state_notes: group 'Alignment'; keytip Alt, J L, B C; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Align Bottom Right

icon.description: Align Bottom Right control (see icon crop)

children.tooltip: Align text to the bottom right corner of the cell.
children.state_notes: group 'Alignment'; keytip Alt, J L, B R; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Text Direction
children.tooltip:
Change the text direction within the selected cells.

Click the button multiple times to cycle through the available directions.
children.state_notes: group 'Alignment'; keytip Alt, J L, G; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Cell Margins...
children.tooltip: Customize cell margins and the spacing between cells.
children.state_notes: group 'Alignment'; keytip Alt, J L, N; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Sort...
children.tooltip:
Arrange the current selection in alphabetical or numerical order.

This is especially useful if you're trying to organize data in a table.
children.state_notes: group 'Data'; keytip Alt, J L, S O; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Repeat Header Rows

icon.description: Repeat Header Rows control (see icon crop)

children.tooltip:
Mark multiple rows as header rows.

If your table spans multiple pages the header rows will appear on every page for easy reference.
children.state_notes: group 'Data'; keytip Alt, J L, J; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Convert to Text...

icon.description: Convert to Text... control (see icon crop)

children.tooltip:
Convert the table to regular text.

You can choose which text character to use to separate the columns.
children.state_notes: group 'Data'; keytip Alt, J L, V; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Formula...
children.tooltip: Add a formula to a cell to perform a simple calculation, such as AVERAGE, SUM, or COUNT.
children.state_notes: group 'Data'; keytip Alt, J L, U L; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)
